title: Concept: Package source declared over cleartext
description: nuget.config declares a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext.
